props.label: Outlook
props.description:
Outlook days (Positive Integer value) is added to today's date, all production orders with a scheduled Start less than or equal the future date to will be shown.
In order to use the Scheduled Start At Filter - you must first remove the outlook days value. You may use one or the other, but not both.
